pairs: to Ariel the city against which David fought:
year has been added to year,
And I will surround Ariel with siege works,
and it will be in sorrow and mourning,
and it will be like Ariel to me.
Et circumdabo quasi sphæram in circuitu tuo,
And I will surround you like a sphere all around you,
and I will raise up a rampart against you,
et munimenta ponam in obsidionem tuam.
and I will set up fortifications to blockade you.
You will speak from the ground,
et de humo audietur eloquium tuum;
and your eloquence will be heard from the dirt. And,
et erit quasi pythonis de terra vox tua,
from the ground, your voice will be like that of the python,
et de humo eloquium tuum mussitabit.
and your eloquence will mumble from the dirt.
Et erit sicut pulvis tenuis multitudo ventilantium te,
And the multitude of those who fan you will be like fine dust.
et sicut favilla pertransiens multitudo eorum qui contra te prævaluerunt;
And the multitude of those who have prevailed against you will be like embers fading away.
And this will happen suddenly and swiftly.
A Domino exercituum visitabitur in tonitruo, et commotione terræ,
It will be visited from the Lord of hosts with thunder and earthquakes,
et voce magna turbinis et tempestatis,
and with the great noise of a whirlwind and a storm,
and with a flame of devouring fire.
Et erit sicut somnium visionis nocturnæ multitudo omnium gentium quæ dimicaverunt contra Ariel,
And the multitude of all the nations that have struggled against Ariel will be like the dream of a vision by night,
along with all who have battled,
Et sicut somniat esuriens, et comedit,
And it will be like one who is hungry and dreams of eating, but,
when he has been awakened, his soul is empty.
vacua est anima ejus; et sicut somniat sitiens et bibit,
And it will be like one who is thirsty and dreams of drinking,
but, after he has been awakened,
lassus adhuc sitit, et anima ejus vacua est:
he still languishes in thirst, and his soul is empty.
sic erit multitudo omnium gentium quæ dimicaverunt contra montem Sion.
So shall the multitude of all the nations be, who have struggled against Mount Zion.
Quoniam miscuit vobis Dominus spiritum soporis;
For the Lord has mixed for you a spirit of deep sleep.
Et erit vobis visio omnium sicut verba libri signati,
And the vision of all will be to you like the words of a sealed book, which,
when they have given it to someone who knows how to read,
But if the book is given to someone who does not know how to read,
and it is said to him,
“I do not know how to read.”
Eo quod appropinquat populus iste ore suo,
Since this people have drawn near to me only with their mouth,
and their lips glorify me while their heart is far from me,
cor autem ejus longe est a me,
and their fear of me is based on the commandments
et timuerunt me mandato hominum et doctrinis,
ideo ecce ego addam ut admirationem faciam populo huic miraculo grandi et stupendo;
for this reason, behold, I will proceed to accomplish a wonder for this people,
peribit enim sapientia a sapientibus ejus,
a great and mystifying miracle. For wisdom will perish from their wise,
and the understanding of their prudent will be concealed.
Woe to you who use the depths of the heart,
so that you may hide your intentions from the Lord.
Their works are done in darkness,
This intention of yours is perverse.
quasi si lutum contra figulum cogitet,
It is as if the clay were to plan against the potter,
or as if the work were to say to its maker:
Or it is as if what has been formed were to say to the one who formed it,
In not more than a little while and a brief time,
et in brevi convertetur Libanus in carmel,
Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field,
and a fruitful field will be considered to be a forest.
Et audient in die illa surdi verba libri,
the deaf will hear the words of a book,
and out of darkness and obscurity the eyes of the blind will see.
Et addent mites in Domino lætitiam,
And the meek will increase their rejoicing in the Lord,
et pauperes homines in Sancto Israël exsultabunt;
and the poor among men will exult in the Holy One of Israel.
For the one who was prevailing has failed,
the one who was mocking has been consumed,
et succisi sunt omnes qui vigilabant super iniquitatem,
and all those who were standing guard over iniquity have been cut down.
qui peccare faciebant homines in verbo,
For they caused men to sin by a word,
and they supplanted him who argued against them at the gates,
and they turned away from justice in vain.
hæc dicit Dominus ad domum Jacob,
thus says the Lord, he who has redeemed Abraham,
From now on, Jacob will not be confounded;
from now on his countenance will not blush with shame.
Instead, when he sees his children,
opera manuum mearum in medio sui sanctificantes nomen meum,
they will be the work of my hands in his midst, sanctifying my name,
and they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob,
and they will preach the God of Israel.
And those who had gone astray in spirit will know understanding,
and those who had murmured will learn the law.
